Name: Fish's Flowers (Hyacinth and Pansy) - Compatibility Version
Author: metalax
Description:
This is a compatibility mod of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3553]Fish's Flowers (Hyacinth and Pansy)[/url] to make it compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2075]PPJA - Farmer to Florist[/url].

It simply renames the Hyacinth to Grape Hyacinth.

[size=4]Installation:[/size]
[list=1]
[*] Install [url=https://www.smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]
[*] Unzip the download and move the [code][JA] Fish's Flowers[/code] folder into [code]../Stardew Valley/Mods[/code].
[*] Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
If you already had 'Fish's Flowers (Hyacinth and Pansy)' installed, and [b]don't[/b] have 'PPJA - Farmer to Florist' currently installed, ensure any Hyacinth & Hyacinth Seeds have been sold or trashed and allow the game to save, then delete the [code][JA] Fish's Flowers[/code] folder from the [code]../Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] before installing from this mod.
If you already had 'Fish's Flowers (Hyacinth and Pansy)' installed, and [b]do[/b] have 'PPJA - Farmer to Florist' currently installed, just delete the [code][JA] Fish's Flowers[/code] folder from the [code]../Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] before installing from this mod.

Seeds may be purchased from Pierre's.
Pansies grow in spring, summer and fall.
Hyacinth grows in spring.
